text:
Amr Moussa, Secretary-General of the Arab League from 2001 to 2011, sponsored the first Arab Creativity Oscar, which went to Kuwaiti Qari Mishary Alafasy in Egypt, most likely on 25 October 2008. This rests on search snippets from EverybodyWiki and Barakah Insider, not primary sources. I did not verify the team note that the Arab Creativity Union is Tunis-based, Arab League-founded, and mainly awards film directors, so I am not relying on it.

CONFIDENCE: 65
